# AppsRank

> AppsRank is an App Store ranking tracker for iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later). It shows live Top Free, Top Paid and Top Grossing charts for 170+ countries and 25+ categories, records the rank of the apps you track, compares up to 3 competitors and can send rank alerts.

Price model: free to download with ads. AppsRank Pro (weekly or monthly subscription, or one-time lifetime purchase) unlocks every country, 30-day history, more tracked apps, Compare and Rank Alerts, and removes ads. No account needed; tracked apps and history stay on the device. Rankings come from Apple's public iTunes feeds.

Made by Visto Apps (https://vistoapps.com), the brand of Darius Cirjan. Contact: iosallapps@gmail.com
